thread:
emily.csm: Heads-up: HarborFin showing clear hesitancy — usage down ~45% last 30d, AE flagged downgrade request, renewal in 38 days. Need a quick intercept play.
raj.ae: Ack. What triggered the downgrade request? price? product? integration?
maria_success: From last touch: two support tickets about webhook retries + feature gap on historic indexing. They also said ROI charts aren't landing with execs.
emily.csm: Exact. My read: operational pain (webhooks), + lack of executive-facing ROI narrative. They softened ask — keep core but drop 2 noncritical add-ons if price not addressed.
zach_se: I can spare 2h for deep-dive on webhook errors and propose configuration fix. Can we get logs and client config?
emily.csm: I'll pull logs and convo excerpts and paste them here in 30m. Suggest play: 1) Immediate 15m exec ROI micro-report 2) Tech root-cause + quick config patch (SE) 3) Offer "downgrade cushion" for 60 days + feature hold 4) Capture feedback loop for product.
oliver_pm: +1 to feedback loop. If it's a product gap on historic indexing we should log as severity 2 and attach a short repro. Can someone capture exact asks from customer?
maria_success: I have the notes from Oct 6 call. Copying key lines: "We need reliable historical search for compliance audits" and "current export is manual and painful".
emily.csm: thanks. Action owners: emily.csm — lead exec micro-report; raj.ae — negotiate cushion terms; zach_se — triage and temporary patch; oliver_pm — capture product ticket and prioritization; kelly_manager — if we need uplift or credits, pls weigh in.
kelly_manager: happy to authorize a 25% promotional credit for 60 days as a retention experiment, limited to this account. Need exec summary before signoff.
emily.csm: I'll drop a 1-pager ROI micro-report in this thread before EOD. Template below I'll use:
```
- Executive summary (1 line)
- 3-month ROI snapshot (savings & risk avoided)
- Top 2 action items we will deliver in 14 days
- Recommended temporary commercial cushion
```
raj.ae: For the cushion phrasing: "60-day downgrade cushion — retain current seat pricing and support; optional removal of two noncritical add-ons with prorated credit. Re-evaluate 30d before renewal." sound ok?
maria_success: sounds reasonable. Also propose an "enablement micro-sess" for their admins (30m) to reduce support noise.
zach_se: Quick technical note — for webhook retries common culprit is a 502/504 from customer infra causing backoff. I can add a temporary retry-window increase and enable request draining for 48h. Need svc account and sample webhook payload.
emily.csm: I'll share svc creds and the payload in a DM. Also pushing to schedule the 30m admin enablement this week. Can someone volunteer to run it?
maria_success: I can run the enablement session Friday morning. I'll prepare short checklist and screen-sharing steps.
oliver_pm: I'll create the product ticket: title "historic-indexing: customer workaround -> product fix" and link here. ETA to triage: 2 business days.
emily.csm: Great. Retention-bot, please add a follow-up reminder 10 days from now and tag this thread.
retention-bot: Reminder set for 10 days (3355551234 + 864000). Will ping channel with status check.
emily.csm: Final ask — if anyone hears pushback from their side (legal/compliance), please flag immediately. Goal: avoid churn and keep them on plan while we deliver fixes and exec ROI narrative. :thumbsup:
raj.ae: I'll draft negotiation language and share for review in an hour.
maria_success: I'll attach the call excerpt and the admin checklist once ready.
zach_se: I'll start triage now and post a short runbook here when I have the immediate mitigation steps.
kelly_manager: Keep me posted; if we need more than promo credit we'll revisit but try this cushion first.
emily.csm: Thanks team — I'll post the ROI 1-pager here when ready. Closing loop later today. :handshake:
